question: Chittaranjan Das, fondly called ‘Deshbandhu’, was born on November 5, 1870, in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chittaranjan Das**, also known as **C.R. Das**, was born on **November 5, 1870**, in the city of **Calcutta** (now **Kolkata**), which was the administrative hub of **British India**.
